message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Operating Leverage", "construction": "Change in operating income divided by change in sales over the past 12 months, as reported in quarterly filings.", "rationale": "Firms with high operating leverage are more sensitive to economic shocks, which may be underappreciated and thus mispriced by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Growth Deceleration", "construction": "One-year change in inventory growth rate: (Inventory_t - Inventory_{t-1}) / Inventory_{t-1} minus (Inventory_{t-1} - Inventory_{t-2}) / Inventory_{t-2}, using annual Compustat items.", "rationale": "A deceleration in inventory growth may signal improving demand-supply balance and potential positive future surprises.", "higher_returns_for": "high deceleration (i.e., negative values)"}, {"name": "Seasonal Sales Momentum", "construction": "Sales growth in the most recent fiscal quarter relative to the same quarter last year: (Sales_{q,t} - Sales_{q,t-4}) / Sales_{q,t-4}.", "rationale": "Seasonal patterns in sales growth may provide more timely signals about business momentum than annual growth rates.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Omission Indicator", "construction": "A binary variable indicating whether a firm has omitted dividends this year after paying in each of the previous three years.", "rationale": "Dividend omissions may be viewed overly negatively by the market, resulting in return reversals for omitted firms.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with recent dividend omissions"}, {"name": "Relative Employee Productivity", "construction": "Total sales over the past year divided by the number of employees (from 10-K filings), normalized by industry median.", "rationale": "Higher productivity may indicate better management practices or operational efficiency not yet reflected in prices.", "higher_returns_for": "high values relative to industry median"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Asset Ratio", "construction": "Deferred tax assets divided by total assets, from the most recent annual balance sheet.", "rationale": "Firms with high deferred tax assets might have future tax shields leading to higher after-tax profits.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Insider Option Grant Intensity", "construction": "Number of stock options granted to insiders over the past 12 months divided by shares outstanding, as reported in proxy statements.", "rationale": "Large insider grants may signal undervaluation or future growth expectations that external investors have not yet priced in.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Receivables Accruals Ratio", "construction": "Change in accounts receivable over the past year divided by average total assets, from annual financial statements.", "rationale": "Receivables growth may indicate aggressive revenue recognition, which can predict lower future returns if overestimated.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Intensity Surprise", "construction": "Current year R&D expenditure divided by sales, minus the mean of this ratio over the prior three years.", "rationale": "A sudden jump in R&D intensity may signal new growth initiatives or product cycles not yet recognized by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high positive surprises"}, {"name": "Supplier Concentration Ratio", "construction": "Sum of the top three suppliers' purchase percentages (from 10-K disclosures) as a fraction of total purchases.", "rationale": "Firms with low supplier concentration may have more bargaining power and supply chain resilience, which could boost future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}]}
